description: Use this tool whenever a user asks to project retirement readiness, sustainable real annual spending, Pre-Tax / Roth / Taxable withdrawal tax blending, Social Security and pension bridging, healthcare costs, and 1,000-trial Monte Carlo plan longevity across ages 18 to 100.

annualHealthcareCost.description: Estimated annual out-of-pocket retirement healthcare cost in USD.

annualPensionIncome.description: Annual guaranteed pension income in USD.

currentNestEgg.description: Current total retirement savings across all buckets in USD.

effectiveTaxRatePct.description: Estimated effective retirement ordinary tax rate percentage.

monthlyContribution.description: Ongoing monthly retirement savings contribution in USD.

monthlySocialSecurity.description: Estimated monthly Social Security benefit in today's USD.

pretaxSharePct.description: Share of retirement assets in Pre-Tax accounts (401(k)/Traditional IRA) as %.

riskProfile.description: Portfolio risk profile governing expected return and volatility.

rothSharePct.description: Share of retirement assets in Tax-Free Roth accounts as %.

taxableSharePct.description: Share of retirement assets in Taxable brokerage accounts as %.

yearsInRetirement.description: Planned years in retirement (e.g. 30 years from 65 to 95).

name: plan_retirement_income_and_longevity
title: Plan Multi-Bucket Retirement Income, Real Nest-Egg Compounding & Monte Carlo Longevity
